join hortbot 999 foobar 1
join hortbot 999 otherchan 9


handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 access=admin :!admin imp
no_send

handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 access=super-admin :!admin imp
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Usage: !admin imp <channel> <message>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var set fbvar 1
send_any


handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 access=super-admin :!admin imp foobar !var get fbvar
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Variable fbvar is set to: 1

handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 access=super-admin :!admin imp foobar !var increment fbvar 310
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Variable fbvar has been incremented to 311.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var get fbvar
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable fbvar is set to: 311


handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 access=super-admin :!admin imp who !var get fbvar
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Channel who does not exist.
